authorization.scientistReview: https://github.com/mfs9697/NewMetacomp/issues/47#issuecomment-7068731805 (decision 3: GO one focused frozen-S2 alternative-family subset check)
authorization.basePR: draft PR #49, reviewed head ece74694b1c09be95fdcab2afac9d6fef7322602 (verified unchanged before work)
authorization.historicalPolicies: G2_M4_POLICY_v1.json and G2_M4B_POLICY_v2.json stay byte-identical; this file is the prospective record for R1 only

scope: cross-family verification of single-ring placement effects (and stiff {1,3}) on the MATCHED frozen S2alt mesh: exactly the original saved S2 crack polyline and terminal tangent, independently regenerated 112-chord ring polygons and finer exterior; NO crack segment, NO trajectory, NO State 3, NO M4.C, NO full factorial, NO I_ij/I_123 re-computation, NO interface fracture, NO CZM, NO optimization, NO physical onset/arrest claim

reference.state: S2alt of PR #38 run D (M2): g2_kinked_join on the SAVED full-precision S2 polyline with GuideHface 1.0 mm, Hmax 5 mm

matchedOriginal.rule: crackPolyline, tipTangent and the physical tip coordinates of S2alt must be BITWISE equal (isequal) to the original S2; p010 core / collar / q-active row counts equal (2788 / 128 / 2443); otherwise HOLD_MATCHED_S2ALT before any solve
matchedOriginal.forbiddenSubstitute: the M4.A alternative homogeneous S2 (outputs/g2_m4_alt_family_v1/chain_homogeneous_alt_v1/STEP_002), whose crack shape differs

originalFamilyResults.rule: every original-family case record used in the comparison must match its row in the committed M4.B ledger; the M4.B records are read only

reference.areaNote: 112-gon ring polygon area 1012.852964 mm2 vs 76-gon 1012.152529 mm2 (+0.0692 %); R1 tests exterior + polygon-boundary family sensitivity, not element-size convergence and not near-tip (p010) sensitivity

rings: unchanged from G2_M4B_POLICY_v2.json rings block (IDs by ascending y; inactive ring = matrix modulus; holes void; ownerRing from PM.annulusOf cross-checked by g2_m4b_ring_owner_oracle)

design.legacyControls: g2_material_sif_on_mesh (unchanged) on c0p5_111 and c2p0_111, as in M4.B
design.anchorReuse: anchors are re-solved and must equal the accepted M2 S2alt records bitwise; no saved anchor is used as a substitute for a solve
design.caseOutsideDesign: any other id (including the other M4.B masks) is refused before any solve: HOLD_CASE_OUTSIDE_DESIGN

authorization_token.campaign: G2M4BR1RUN|<R1 policy SHA-256>|src=<g2_m4b_r1_sources set SHA-256>|mesh=<S2alt mesh SHA-256>|cases=10
authorization_token.perCaseRecord: G2M4BR1CASE|<R1 policy SHA-256>|src=<source-set SHA-256>|mesh=<S2alt mesh SHA-256>|c=<0.5|2|none>|mask=<bits>
authorization_token.dryDefault: dry run reads and checks only, writes nothing

gates.B0: release R2023a, PDE Toolbox, >= 5 GiB free RAM (cannot be lowered), one MATLAB, clean tree for Run, policy/module pins, S2alt mesh / baseline / phase-map SHAs + ledger rows, matched-geometry rule
gates.B1: g2_kinked_mesh_auditor 34/34 on S2alt; g2_m2_state_adapter('S2alt'); legacy phase map = saved PHASE_MAP_S2alt; legacy verifier + check_g2_m2_phase_controls PASS; owner oracle = annulusOf on the 112-chord geometry; g2_m4b_activation_verify PASS for all 10 cases with expectedChords 112; check_g2_m4b_activation_negatives 10/10 on S2alt
gates.B2: none = CASE_S2alt_H1 bitwise (u, EDI_all, EDI4x4, COD, CMOD, compliance); c0p5_111 / c2p0_111 = CASE_S2alt_Msoft / Mstiff bitwise (u, EDI, 4x4, COD, J, compliance, CMOD, reactions, total and phase energy); legacy g2_material_sif_on_mesh PASS and equal; labels of 111 = PM.phase. Failure = HOLD_BASELINE_REGRESSION
gates.B3: the seven targets pass all inherited SIF gates and the partial-activation gates of g2_m4b_sif_partial (unchanged)

comparison.observables: per case: signed K_I, K_II (EDI 6x6 primary, four other annuli, 4x4, COD), J, G, theta_MTS (S2 tip frame, identical in both families), compliance, CMOD, total and per-ring strain energy; per target: F_G = G(S)/G(none) - 1 and F_theta = theta(S) - theta(none), each with its OWN family's none
comparison.uncertaintyPerFamily: primary (paired estimator variants, |Q| > 2U and COD sign) and conservative (uncorrelated, |Q| > U_cons and COD sign for G; |Q| > U_cons for theta) exactly as G2_M4B_POLICY_v2.json, computed separately on each family; reported side by side with the cross-family drift (three different questions)

classPerTarget.UNRESOLVED: Q is not resolved under the primary rule in at least one family (no sign statement)
classPerTarget.NOT_ROBUST: both resolved under the primary rule and sign(Q_alt) ~= sign(Q_orig)
classPerTarget.thresholdOrigin: 0.10 relative is the robustness threshold of the G2_M2_POLICY_v1 S2alt classification for the same mesh pair; fixed here before any R1 result

comparison.rankingEqualArea: for each contrast and observable: the signed order of (f_1, f_2, f_3) in each family; each difference d_ij = f_i - f_j classified with the same four classes; RANKING_STABLE iff the permutation is identical and no d_ij is NOT_ROBUST; RANKING_UNRESOLVED if any d_ij is UNRESOLVED and no sign flip; otherwise RANKING_CHANGED
comparison.stiff13: classes of F_G and F_theta for c2p0_101; its F_G position among the alternative-family stiff cases evaluated here ({1}, {2}, {3}, {1,3}, {1,2,3}) is reported as UNEQUAL-AREA CONTEXT only; no other two-ring set is computed on S2alt, so no equal-area two-ring statement is made
comparison.anchors: cross-family drift of none and 111 reported (K, G, theta, compliance); the 111 F_G must reproduce the M2 S2alt classification (ROBUST)

verdict.R1_PLACEMENT_STABLE: all 12 single-ring classes (3 rings x 2 contrasts x {F_G, F_theta}) STABLE and all four rankings RANKING_STABLE
verdict.R1_PLACEMENT_SENSITIVE: no NOT_ROBUST and no RANKING_CHANGED, but at least one SENSITIVE or UNRESOLVED
verdict.R1_NOT_ROBUST: any single-ring NOT_ROBUST or any RANKING_CHANGED
verdict.HOLD: any gate failure; no comparison is made

comparison.notClaimed: no I_ij / I_123, no Shapley values, no equal-cost two-ring ranking, no mesh-convergence statement

faultTests: matched-geometry rule rejects the M4.A alternative S2 and a perturbed polyline
owner / mask / midside / q / void / modulus mutations on the 112-gon
case outside the R1 design (e.g. c0p5_110)
byte-tampered, KII-reversed re-signed, unledgered and forged records
accepted M2, M4.B and R1 runs unchanged

figures.greyscale: monotonic greyscale colormap (black to white) for print; signed fields with a bold zero contour, solid positive and dashed negative contour lines; common limits for cross-case comparison, separately labelled local-limit versions where useful
figures.language: Ukrainian for every title, axis, legend, colour bar and annotation
figures.data: only accepted records of R1, M4.B and M2 (stresses post-processed from saved displacements with the unchanged g2_t6_point_stress); no extra solves for figures

word: per the owner's Issue #50 prompt: a small native Ukrainian Word proposal package (R1 section, greyscale figures, captions, the G2-REV-M4B review decisions as insertion-ready text) for the next consolidated revision; v0.4 candidate and v0.3 untouched; every produced page rendered and inspected
reviewStop: REVIEW_STOP_R1 after one consolidated packet; long matrix-only paths, M4.C, 27 mixed layouts, State 3, CZM, interface penetration/delamination and arrest claims are NOT authorized
